device.description: 16-bit 2.048 MSPS dual simultaneous-sampling SAR ADC with integrated reference buffers and dual-SDO-per-channel serial interface
device.note: ads9226.pdf (SBAS842) p.3-4 pin configuration and functions, p.5 recommended operating conditions (DVDD 1.65-5.5 V), p.8 timing requirements and switching characteristics (tCONV 422 ns, tDEN_CSDO 14 ns, tDZ_CSDO 13 ns, tD_CKDO 16 ns), p.10 Figure 6-3 (SCLK high at CS fall, capture on falling edges, launch on rising edges), p.18 Table 7-1 (two's complement, mid code 0000h), p.20-21 7.4 (conversion starts on the CS rising edge; output word left-justified and split over SDO-1x (D15, D13 .. D1) and SDO-0x (D14, D12 .. D0), first bits launched at CS fall, zeros after the word)

pages: p.3-4 (pinout and pin functions), p.5 (ROC), p.8 (timing requirements, switching characteristics), p.9-10 (Figures 6-1 to 6-3), p.18 (Table 7-1 transfer characteristics), p.20-21 (7.4 functional modes, output data word, data transfer frame)
notModeled: FOUR DATA LANES: each ADC drives its 16-bit word on two SDO pins (SDO-1x: D15, D13 .. D1; SDO-0x: D14, D12 .. D0), A on SDO-1A / SDO-0A and B on SDO-1B / SDO-0B, all at once; the schema has one miso, so only SDO-1A is modeled (the odd bits of the channel-A result) and SDO-0A, SDO-1B, SDO-0B are never driven
analog inputs, reference buffers (REFIN, REFP_x / REFM_x): the result is always the 0 V code 0000h (two's complement)
latency-0 / latency-1 data capture (Figures 6-1, 6-2): the frame always shows the most recent completed conversion
cycle time 488 ns, acquisition time and SCLK limits (32.768 MHz); DVDD 2.35 V minimum for SCLK > 20 MHz
the two CS pins (13, 14) must be connected together externally; the model treats both as CS
